description: Turn a moment in time into Discord timestamp codes like <t:1767225600:F>. Give either `unix`, an ISO `datetime` with offset, or a local `date` + `time` + IANA `timezone` (best when the user says e.g. "8pm New York time"). Omit `format` to get all 7 styles (t, T, d, D, f, F, R).

date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD (use with time and timezone).

format.description: One Discord style. Omit for all.

unix.description: Unix time in seconds or milliseconds.

name: discord_timestamp
title: Make a Discord timestamp
